'''Succors''' are a type of [[Mobs]], placed into the [[Preeminent Parasites|Preeminent]] Tier.

== ''Spawning<ref>Succors technically require a [[Colony]] to exist in order to be able to spawn, but since all Preeminent Parasites that spawn them also do, this boundary is redundant.</ref>'' ==
* Succors are summoned by other [[Preeminent Parasites]].  A Succor cannot spawn more Succors.

== ''Behavior'' ==
Succors are Flying Utility/Projectile units.
*When a Succor flies close to an enemy, it will either: 
**Explode into [[Remains|Pure Remains]], placing [[Residue]], dealing 2x the base damage of the Parasite that spawned it, and spawn a cloud that inflicts Poison, Wither, and [[Call Of The Hive|COTH]].
**Deploy an [[Orb]] (Carrying the Orb effects of Parasite who spawned the Succor).
**Teleport the Parasite that spawned it to itself.
* After it does one of these actions, it will disappear and die.
*Succors can break blocks that have their [[Hardness]] Value up to 15, with a 20 ticks cooldown and 2 Blocks range.

=== ''Weaknesses'' ===
*Succors, like any other [[Mobs|Mob]], present a weakness to Fire. Damage inflicted by Fire is quadrupled.

=== ''Post Death'' ===
* If a Succor is killed before it can use one of its abilities, it will either Explode into Residue (as it would if it was near a target) or die normally.

==''Trivia''==
*Succors are also known as '''Flam''' in the Mod Files.
*The word "succor" means aid or something that brings it, fitting a Parasite summoned to provide aid to Preeminents.
